messages:
sara: CI red on main after merge of #492 — snapshot suite failing (12 snapshots). Seems like prompt-renderer serialization changed. Anyone seen a minimal repro yet?

ci-bot: Build 2109994320 failed: job=unit/snapshots (12 fails) — https://ci.redwood/2109994320/logs

matt: I skimmed the logs, looks like a trailing-space/whitespace difference in serialized prompts. quick diff from one failing golden: 
```
-"Welcome to Redwood!"
+"Welcome to Redwood! "
```

alex: Can we avoid a full rebuild? please rerun just the snapshot job — that'll tell us if it's flaky or a deterministic regression.

jamie: I can run a targeted rerun. use: `./ci rerun --job=snapshots --build=2109994320` 
I also have a local minimal repro script: `python tools/snap_repro.py --case=prompt/compose`

nayan: If it's serializer churn, try toggling the new rust serializer flag locally: `RUSTFLAGS="" cargo test -p prompt-renderer -- --nocapture` — sometimes compiler optim changes whitespace handling on small strings.

sara: @jamie can you kick the rerun and paste the retry link? if it passes, probably a flake. if it fails, we bisect.

jamie: kicked it: https://ci.redwood/2109994320/retry/1 — still failing, same token-level diff. quick stack snippet: 
```
prompt_renderer::serialize::to_json_line  (src/serialize.rs:124)
prompt_renderer::render::render_prompt (src/render.rs:78)
```

matt: OK going to start a quick git bisect across recent serializer changes. suggested flow: 
1) `git bisect start`
2) `git bisect bad` (current HEAD)
3) `git bisect good v1.2.8` (last green tag)
4) run `./scripts/run_snapshot_case.sh prompt/compose` per commit

alex: small optimization: bisect with `--no-cache` and `--no-quantize` flags so we isolate serialization diffs rather than quantization noise. @matt can you run that?

matt: Starting bisect now with `./scripts/bisect_runner.sh --case=prompt/compose --no-quantize`. ETA ~25m, will post first bad commit.

sara: awesome — if bisect points to the serializer crate, let's prepare a revert or a small patch that preserves previous whitespace trimming. tagging this thread with regressions/snapshots. :thumbsup:

jamie: added a tiny helper to the repro that prints exact byte sequences so we can see if it's trailing space vs null byte. sharing output shortly.

nayan: FYI, I hit a similar thing last month — serializer used `to_string()` on bytes which changed after a dependency bump. if bisect lands there, check that conversion.

matt: first bad commit identified: `6f3a9b2` — includes `serde` bump + change to `escape_str` behavior. opening PR to revert the escape change and run constrained test.

sara: great catch. @matt please include an assertion in the test that preserves exact previous serialized string (so future changes will fail CI). I'll shepherd the revert PR once CI is green.

ci-bot: Build 2109994321 started for matt/6f3a9b2 (retest) — https://ci.redwood/2109994321/logs

sara: thanks everyone — will follow up in the PR. if anyone has short repro improvements, drop them in this thread.
